subject: Game Theory
title: First-Mover Advantage
description: A micro-lesson that makes First-Mover Advantage usable.

hook.text: Amazon, Uber, and Google all moved first in their markets. Is being first always an advantage?

buildup.text: First movers capture customers, build brand loyalty, and set industry standards before rivals arrive.

discovery.text: In game theory, the first mover 'commits'—forcing competitors to react to a fait accompli.

twist.text: But first movers also bear all the risk and cost. Facebook beat earlier social networks by learning from them.

climax.text: The advantage depends on switching costs. High switching costs reward first movers. Low costs reward fast followers.

punchline.text: First isn't always best. Fastest is.
